description: Get geolocation data (country, region, city, ISP, ASN) for an IP address, domain, or email. Falls back to the caller's IP if no input is provided. Use this when assessing whether a connection or registration originates from an unexpected geography. Do NOT use this for IP netblock / ASN ownership queries (use `ip_netblocks`) or when you have many IPs to enrich (use `bulk_ip_geolocation`).

domain_name.description: Domain address. Cannot be used with ip_address or email_address.

email_address.description: Email address. Cannot be used with ip_address or domain_name.

ip_address.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. Cannot be used with domain_name or email_address.

reverse_ip.description: If true, returns 5 domains associated with the IP address.

name: ipgeolocation
